reason: Scraper core architecture is cleanly decoupled from concrete domains, uses strict service provider registration and ambient context isolation through alex-kassel/laravel-domain-core.
scope_checked: Public API surface (ScraperEngineService, DataSyncService, RawContentCache, AbstractSpider)
Ambient context and execution locking integration

findings.title: ScraperCoreServiceProvider does not provide standard publishable config or migration tags
findings.description: ScraperCoreServiceProvider does not register publishes() tags for default package config or standalone database migrations, relying solely on domain context registration in AbstractScrapingServiceProvider.
findings.evidence: ScraperCoreServiceProvider::boot() only registers console commands without publishes() tags or mergeConfigFrom().
findings.recommendation: Provide config publication and migration publication tags in ScraperCoreServiceProvider for standalone or hybrid consumer configurations.

findings.title: Internal pipeline processors in src/Processors lack @internal annotations
findings.description: SaveRawContentProcessor and ConsoleProgressProcessor are internal engine components meant to be configured by AbstractSpider, but lack @internal class annotations.
findings.evidence: Class SaveRawContentProcessor and ConsoleProgressProcessor are public in PSR-4 root without docblock boundary markup.
findings.recommendation: Add @internal docblock annotations to internal pipeline processors.
